title: Euno, whose platform reconstructs data flow, meaning, health, and more across data environments to give agents context, raised a $23M Series A led by N47 (Chris Metinko/Axios)
summary: Chris Metinko / Axios: Euno, whose platform reconstructs data flow, meaning, health, and more across data environments to give agents context, raised a $23M Series A led by N47 — Euno, an enterprise AI context platform, raised a $23 million Series A led by N47, Euno CEO Sarah Levy tells Axios Pro exclusively.
